source: Project Operating System Phase 2 - Migration Engine
description: Official rollback model for future migrations.

rollback.trigger: failed gate, failed post-check or manual decision

steps: Identify every file changed by the migration.
Restore each file listed in previousState.filesToRestore from the captured baseline.
Confirm no blocked file was changed.
Record rollback outcome in the migration report.

requiredChecks: git diff confirms migrated files returned to baseline

notes: Rollback must be ready before any future migration is approved.
This template documents rollback procedure and does not restore files automatically.
